source: scripts/aem.js + scripts/scripts.js of this repo (aem-boilerplate 1.3.0 vintage, read 2026-10-08)
blockWrapper: decorateBlock adds .block + data-block-name and wraps the block in div.<name>-wrapper; the section gains .<name>-container
buttonizationNote:
decorateButtons() requires an authored / ancestor (strong = primary, em = secondary, both = accent); a bare alone in a

stays a plain link; the emphasis tag is replaced by the classed anchor
chromeLoad: loadHeader(body > header) + loadFooter(body > footer) in loadLazy; header .header / footer .footer are visibility:hidden until data-block-status=loaded; header reserves height: var(--nav-height)
chromePathResolution: blocks/header + blocks/footer: page metadata nav/footer when present, else by locale from the first path segment (de → /de/nav + /de/footer, otherwise /nav + /footer) — helper getChromePath() in scripts/scripts.js
sectionMetadataRendering: decorateSections() client-side: section-metadata style → section classes, other keys → data-*
fontsLoad: loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css eagerly on viewports >= 900px or with the fonts-loaded session flag, otherwise in loadLazy
extras: trustedTypes default policy, CSP meta in head.html (script-src nonce + strict-dynamic), consent-check.js in loadDelayed
